4. Click (51, 40) - orange diamond outline → square moved

6. Click (18, 57) - purple ring → square moved
7. Click (30, 56) - light blue region → square moved
8. Click (7, 49) - orange diamond → NO movement (just toggled G↔W)
9. Click (16, 57) - purple diamond → NO movement (just toggled G↔W)
10. Click (49, 40) - orange diamond outline → NO movement (just toggled G↔W)
So the square moves when I click:
- Light blue regions (S)
- The purple ring (p pixels around the white diamond)
- The orange diamond outline (O pixels)
But NOT when I click:
- The diamond body itself (G or W pixels)

So to move the square, I need to click on the OUTLINE of the diamond or the light blue regions.
